page.layout: Two columns of an index, set in Greek with page numbers. The left column holds the full entries with their numbers. The right column is cut off at the scan edge, so only its word beginnings are legible. Section letters Λ and Μ stand as headings between the groups. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed in this part.; One page of index in three columns of entries with page numbers at the right; section letters N., Ξ., O. are set as headings between the entries.; One page of an index in two columns of Greek words with page numbers at the right; section letters Π, Ρ, Σ set as headings between entries. Page numbers at the far right edge of the scan are cut off in part.; One page of an index in two columns of entries with page references at the right; the Greek headword column runs down the page, the references are set flush right beside each line. A final line "Ταυίς" sits alone at the foot.

page.notes: The right-hand column is cut off by the scan edge; its entries are shown only as far as their first letters are visible, and the remainder is illegible. Several Greek words in the left column are uncertain and are marked [?]. The printed page is a Greek index, and the Greek is copied as seen, without correction. Lines are cut at the left edge; initial letters of many Greek words are missing and are given only as far as legible. Numbers are read from the scan; some Greek is doubtful. Right-hand page numbers are mostly cut off at the scan edge; only the visible digits are given. Greek accents and some letters are doubtful in places, especially in the first entries and in the lines near the right edge. The scan shows only the right-hand part of the page; the left edge is cut away, so leading digits of some lines are missing and the page number is absent. Greek readings are uncertain in several lines and the transcription is approximate where marked by the fragmentary print.
